title: Unicode edge pptx 001
notes: the same six edge strings as docx unicode-edge docx-001 (constants imported from the docx module, so the two fixtures are codepoint-identical by construction) spread as six paragraphs in one text frame: precomposed ligature glyphs U+FB01..U+FB04, the ZWJ family emoji sequence (U+1F468/469/467/466 joined by U+200D), decomposed combining stacks (e+U+0301, a+U+0302+U+0301), NBSP-separated sentence, soft hyphens U+00AD inside one long word — stored byte-exact in the a:t runs, no normalization by the generator. LibreOffice font coverage varies per glyph class: tofu .notdef boxes are a REAL fidelity finding, not a generator bug.
